[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 45
- Description: Fix second Sophia empty-response root cause (non-adjacent tool messages + surface stream errors)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/229
  
  Details:
  Investigated why Sophia still returned '⚠️ Autopilot produced an empty response' on the Public-Key Lookup Cache thread after PR #227. Found a distinct second root cause from box logs: a persisted transcript with a tool result not adjacent to its owning assistant tool_calls -> DeepSeek 400 ('Messages with role tool must be a response to a preceding message with tool_calls') -> streaming /chat emitted an error event with no done -> the Telegram adapter had no error branch -> empty banner. Fixed in PR #229 (merged to main b8b7d37, deploy deferred per Gary while Sophia is mid-task): _sanitise_tool_messages Pass 1 is now adjacency-aware (drops non-adjacent orphan tool messages, Pass 2 re-anchors a synthetic result, self-heals on load and before every turn); the Telegram adapter now surfaces error SSE events with a self-heal/resend hint instead of a blank. Added regression tests (non-adjacent thread-5712 shape, multi-tool-run preserved, adapter error surfacing); full suite 532 passed.
